;; SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
;; Copyright (c) 2026 Hermetica Labs, Inc.

;; @contract hBTC airdrop
;; @version 1

(use-trait ft .sip-010-trait.sip-010-trait)

;;-------------------------------------
;; Constants
;;-------------------------------------

(define-constant ERR_NOT_WHITELISTED (err u109001))
(define-constant ERR_NOT_STANDARD_PRINCIPAL (err u109002))
(define-constant ERR_AMOUNT_BELOW_MIN (err u109003))
(define-constant ERR_TOTAL_AMOUNT_MISMATCH (err u109004))

;;-------------------------------------
;; Variables
;;-------------------------------------

(define-data-var next-airdrop-id uint u0)

;;-------------------------------------
;; Maps
;;-------------------------------------

(define-map whitelist
  {
    address: principal
  }
  {
    active: bool
  }
)

;;-------------------------------------
;; Getters
;;-------------------------------------

(define-read-only (get-whitelist (address principal))
  (default-to
    { active: false }
    (map-get? whitelist { address: address })
  )
)

(define-read-only (get-next-airdrop-id)
  (var-get next-airdrop-id)
)

;;-------------------------------------
;; Helpers
;;-------------------------------------

(define-private (airdrop-processor
  (entry { recipient: principal, amount: uint, memo: (optional (buff 34)) })
  (state { asset: <ft>, result: (response bool uint) }))
  (match (get result state)
    ok-value
      (let (
        (asset (get asset state))
        (recipient (get recipient entry))
        (amount (get amount entry))
      )
        (if (is-eq amount u0)
          { asset: asset, result: ERR_AMOUNT_BELOW_MIN }
          (if (not (is-standard recipient))
            { asset: asset, result: ERR_NOT_STANDARD_PRINCIPAL }
            { asset: asset, result: (contract-call? asset transfer amount current-contract recipient (get memo entry)) }
          )
        )
      )
    err-value state
  )
)

(define-private (add-amounts (entry { recipient: principal, amount: uint, memo: (optional (buff 34)) }) (total uint))
  (+ total (get amount entry))
)

;;-------------------------------------
;; Airdrop
;;-------------------------------------

(define-public (airdrop
  (entries (list 200 { recipient: principal, amount: uint, memo: (optional (buff 34)) }))
  (asset <ft>)
  (purpose (optional (string-ascii 40)))
  (total-amount uint))
  (let (
    (current-airdrop-id (var-get next-airdrop-id)))
    (asserts! (get active (get-whitelist contract-caller)) ERR_NOT_WHITELISTED)
    (asserts! (is-eq total-amount (fold add-amounts entries u0)) ERR_TOTAL_AMOUNT_MISMATCH)
    (var-set next-airdrop-id (+ current-airdrop-id u1))
    (print { airdrop-id: current-airdrop-id, purpose: purpose, asset: (contract-of asset), total-amount: total-amount })
    (get result (fold airdrop-processor entries { asset: asset, result: (ok true) }))
  )
)

;;-------------------------------------
;; Admin
;;-------------------------------------

(define-public (set-whitelist (address principal) (active bool))
  (begin
    (try! (contract-call? .hq-v1 check-is-owner contract-caller))
    (asserts! (is-standard address) ERR_NOT_STANDARD_PRINCIPAL)
    (print { address: address, old-value: (get active (get-whitelist address)), new-value: active })
    (ok (map-set whitelist { address: address } { active: active }))
  )
)

(define-public (transfer (amount uint) (recipient principal) (asset <ft>) (memo (optional (buff 34))))
  (begin
    (try! (contract-call? .hq-v1 check-is-owner contract-caller))
    (ok (try! (contract-call? asset transfer amount current-contract recipient memo)))
  )
)
